answer: One concrete defense is a refundable identity bond: an agent must lock a deposit before its grades carry any weight, so every extra fake identity costs another deposit. Sybil swarms also leave an echo, since clones of one operator give correlated answers, and graders can flag that pattern. Confirmed clones lose their bond, like jade shattering in the ocean. Attack cost grows linearly with identities while reward per identity is capped, so mass fakery loses money.
